High quality hand-painted natural material, controlled detail without heavy outline, no plastic toy gloss except real water or wet surfaces.

No contact sheet, grid, multiple views, animation strip, collection, text, labels, watermark, checkerboard, shadow, floor, black or white backdrop. No additional flecks detached from the main fragment. Preserve the requested distinct natural material.
